content.short: Aevo is a high-performance decentralized derivatives exchange specializing in options and perpetual trading.
content.description: Aevo is a decentralized derivatives exchange focused on providing a professional-grade trading experience for options, perpetuals, and pre-launch tokens. Built on a custom EVM roll-up that settles to Ethereum, Aevo combines the speed and efficiency of an off-chain order book with the security and transparency of on-chain settlement. Traders can access deep liquidity, high leverage, and a wide variety of financial products within an intuitive, low-latency environment. The platform is designed for both retail traders and institutional market makers, ensuring that the derivatives market in Web3 remains competitive, permissionless, and resistant to central points of failure.
content.meta: Aevo is the premier decentralized platform for options and perpetuals trading, featuring an institutional-grade order book and high-speed execution.
